profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Lead a team focused on collection, processing, and storage of many terabytes of data and telemetry from dozens of sources across an enterprise consisting of hundreds of millions of targets.

Design and develop distributed microservices to collect and process very large amounts of data across our nationwide network.  These services feed a an application that allows users to diagnose network problems in real time, to see the details and history of any entity on our network and produce reports to provide aggregated data.

Package and deploy these applications via RPMs using Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery with Jenkins.

Languages: Go, Java, Scala, Ruby
Tools: Apache Spark, RabbitMQ, Git, MySQL, HBase, Kafka, SNMP, Redis, Jenkins, Slack, NewRelic

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Develop a single sign on application (OnePass) designed to provide a single point of entry for commercial banking customers to use many different web applications.  Responsible for adding customizations required for new applications, and new features. The front end uses Backbone, RequireJS, and Thymeleaf.  The back end uses Java, Spring, Apache CXF, and LDAP.
	
Maintain and improve a web application to manage out of band authentication via phone or SMS to control access at critical points such large wire transfers and certain administrative actions. This application is used by several internal application via SOAP and REST web services.  Developed using DojoJS, Java, Spring, CXF and Hibernate.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
2007-2012 - Maintained and improved existing web application written in Java using Struts 1.x and Jsp. Developed several third party interfaces. Implemented Continuous Integration using Hudson/Jenkins 

2012-2015 - Developed replacement for above applications using Java with Spring 3.x (now 4) and JavaScript with ExtJS. Migrated our Hibernate Object model from Hibernate 3.x using xml mappings to Hibernate 4.x with annotations, the build process from ant to maven, and our version control from CVS to Mercurial.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Worked with customers to modify and enhance LoadMaster and LoadMaster Enterprise software to meet the customer's needs and enhance business productivity. These modifications were written in Java and C.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description: Designed and built the control system for the first prototype of the HeartLander, a robot designed to assist in minimally invasive heart surgery.

company.name: Center for Medical Robotics and Computer Assisted Surgery, Carnegie Mellon Robotics Institute

positions.title: Network Technician
positions.description: Installed routers, networks(LANs and WANs), and provided network and server support for many customers. Responsible for coordinating several large network projects involving several sites with customers.
